================================================================================
Heredoc opener ending in and, right side after the body
================================================================================

cat >f <<\EOF &&
x
EOF
echo z

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (redirected_statement
    (command
      (command_name
        (word)))
    (file_redirect
      (word))
    (heredoc_redirect
      (heredoc_start)
      (heredoc_body)
      (heredoc_end)))
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (word)))

================================================================================
Heredoc opener ending in or, body starting with a brace
================================================================================

cat >f <<\EOF ||
{
}
EOF
die x

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (redirected_statement
    (command
      (command_name
        (word)))
    (file_redirect
      (word))
    (heredoc_redirect
      (heredoc_start)
      (heredoc_body)
      (heredoc_end)))
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (word)))

================================================================================
Heredoc opener with a redirect before the operator
================================================================================

cat >g <<-EOF &&
	x
	EOF
echo y

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (redirected_statement
    (command
      (command_name
        (word)))
    (file_redirect
      (word))
    (heredoc_redirect
      (heredoc_start)
      (heredoc_body)
      (heredoc_end)))
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (word)))

================================================================================
Heredoc opener with a same-line right side and a chain
================================================================================

cat <<EOF && echo a && echo b
x
EOF

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (redirected_statement
    (command
      (command_name
        (word)))
    (heredoc_redirect
      (heredoc_start)
      (list
        (command
          (command_name
            (word))
          (word))
        (command
          (command_name
            (word))
          (word)))
      (heredoc_body)
      (heredoc_end))))
